sub_sector.value: diagnostic imaging center management; upright MRI scanner manufacturing

healthcare_segment.detail: Manages diagnostic imaging centers and multi-specialty practices; manufactures Upright Multi-Position MRI scanners.

product_stage.detail: Sells commercial MRI scanners and provides ongoing management services; some research studies.

customer_payer.detail: Medical providers pay management fees; imaging billed to insurers and government payers.

therapeutic_area.detail: Diagnostic MRI imaging across conditions, notably spine, back pain and neurological studies.
